1705: 		
1706: 		/**
1707: 		 * Indicates that the output format should be determined from the
1708: 		 * available information when writing the thumbnail image.
1709: 		 * <p>
1710: 		 * For example, calling this method will cause the output format to be
1711: 		 * determined from the file extension if thumbnails are written to
1712: 		 * files.
1713: 		 * <p>
1714: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1715: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1716: 		 * 
1717: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1718: 		 * @since	0.4.0
1719: 		 */
1720: 		public Builder<T> determineOutputFormat() {
1721: 			updateStatus(Properties.OUTPUT_FORMAT, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1722: 			outputFormat = ThumbnailParameter.DETERMINE_FORMAT;
1723: 			return this;
1724: 		}
1725: 		
1726: 		private boolean isOutputFormatNotSet() {
1727: 			return outputFormat == null || ThumbnailParameter.DETERMINE_FORMAT.equals(outputFormat);
1728: 		}
1729: 		
1730: 		/**
1731: 		 * Sets the compression format type of the thumbnail to write.
1732: 		 * <p>
1733: 		 * If the default type for the compression codec should be used, a
1734: 		 * value of {@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_FORMAT_TYPE} should be
1735: 		 * used.
1736: 		 * <p>
1737: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1738: 		 * <p>
1739: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1740: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1741: 		 * <p>
1742: 		 * Furthermore, if this method is called, then calling the
1743: 		 * {@link #outputFormat} method is disabled, in order to prevent
1744: 		 * cases where the output format type does not exist in the format
1745: 		 * specified for the {@code outputFormat} method.
1746: 		 * <p>
1747: 		 * <em>
1748: 		 * Implementation note:
1749: 		 * Compression format type settings are ignored when the underlying
1750: 		 * image writer does not support compression. This behavior is subject
1751: 		 * to change in the future.
1752: 		 * </em>
1753: 		 *
1754: 		 * @param formatType	The compression format type
1755: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1756: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException	If an unsupported format type is
1757: 		 * 									specified for the current output
1758: 		 * 									format type. Or, if the output
1759: 		 * 									format has not been specified before
1760: 		 * 									this method was called.
1761: 		 */
1762: 		public Builder<T> outputFormatType(String formatType) {
1763: 			/*
1764: 			 * If the output format is the original format, and the format type
1765: 			 * is being specified, it's going to be likely that the specified
1766: 			 * type will not be present in all the formats, so we'll disallow
1767: 			 * it. (e.g. setting type to "JPEG", and if the original formats
1768: 			 * were JPEG and PNG, then we'd have a problem.
1769: 			 */
1770: 			if (formatType != ThumbnailParameter.DEFAULT_FORMAT_TYPE
1771: 					&& isOutputFormatNotSet()) {
1772: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1773: 						"Cannot set the format type if a specific output " +
1774: 						"format has not been specified."
1775: 				);
1776: 			}
1777: 			
1778: 			if (!ThumbnailatorUtils.isSupportedOutputFormatType(outputFormat, formatType)) {
1779: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1780: 						"Specified format type (" + formatType + ") is not " +
1781: 						" supported for the format: " + outputFormat
1782: 				);
1783: 			}
1784: 			
1785: 			/*
1786: 			 * If the output format type is set, then we'd better make the
1787: 			 * output format unchangeable, or else we'd risk having a type
1788: 			 * that is not part of the output format.
1789: 			 */
1790: 			updateStatus(Properties.OUTPUT_FORMAT_TYPE, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1791: 			
1792: 			if (!statusMap.containsKey(Properties.OUTPUT_FORMAT)) {
1793: 				updateStatus(Properties.OUTPUT_FORMAT, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1794: 			}
1795: 			outputFormatType = formatType;
1796: 			return this;
1797: 		}
1798: 		
1799: 		/**
1800: 		 * Sets the watermark to apply on the thumbnail.
1801: 		 * <p>
1802: 		 * This method can be called multiple times to apply multiple
1803: 		 * watermarks.
1804: 		 * <p>
1805: 		 * If multiple watermarks are to be applied, the watermarks will be
1806: 		 * applied in the order that this method is called.
1807: 		 * <p>
1808: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1809: 		 * 
1810: 		 * @param w				The watermark to apply to the thumbnail.
1811: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1812: 		 */
1813: 		public Builder<T> watermark(Watermark w) {
1814: 			if (w == null) {
1815: 				throw new NullPointerException("Watermark is null.");
1816: 			}
1817: 			
1818: 			filterPipeline.add(w);
1819: 			
1820: 			return this;
1821: 		}
1822: 		
1823: 		/**
1824: 		 * <p>
1825: 		 * Sets the image of the watermark to apply on the thumbnail.
1826: 		 * </p>
1827: 		 * <p>
1828: 		 * This method is a convenience method for the
1829: 		 * {@link #watermark(Position, BufferedImage, float)} method, where
1830: 		 * the opacity is 50%, and the position is set to center of the
1831: 		 * thumbnail:
1832: 		 * </p>
1833: 		 * <pre>
1834: watermark(Positions.CENTER, image, 0.5f);
1835: 		 * </pre>
1836: 		 * <p>
1837: 		 * This method can be called multiple times to apply multiple
1838: 		 * watermarks.
1839: 		 * </p>
1840: 		 * <p>
1841: 		 * If multiple watermarks are to be applied, the watermarks will be
1842: 		 * applied in the order that this method is called.
1843: 		 * </p>
1844: 		 * <p>
1845: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1846: 		 * </p>
1847: 		 *
1848: 		 * @param image			The image of the watermark.
1849: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1850: 		 */
1851: 		public Builder<T> watermark(BufferedImage image) {
1852: 			return watermark(Positions.CENTER, image, 0.5f);
1853: 		}
1854: 		
1855: 		/**
1856: 		 * <p>
1857: 		 * Sets the image and opacity of the watermark to apply on
1858: 		 * the thumbnail.
1859: 		 * </p>
1860: 		 * <p>
